result.body:

result.body:

result.body:

details in chat.

cash on delivery order has nothing to refund.

result.body:

result.heading: How we check a fault

result.body:

result.heading: What the warranty covers
result.body:
The warranty covers manufacturing faults. It does not cover physical damage,

You can return home and accessories items within 15 days of delivery.

result.body:
Some items are marked "Not returnable" on the product page. Once unsealed,
they cannot be returned for a change of mind (see "Items you cannot return").

result.heading: How to start a return
result.body:
Ask Nova or open the order page. Nova checks whether the item is inside its
return window and proposes a return. The return starts only after you confirm
it.

result.heading: Refund after cancelling
result.body:
The refund is the full order total, including any shipping charge. We send it at
the moment you cancel (see "Refund timing" for when it reaches you). A cancelled
cash on delivery order has nothing to refund.

result.heading: Refunds for cash on delivery orders
result.body:
Refunds for cash on delivery orders are paid by bank transfer. Add your bank
details on the order page; the refund arrives in 5–7 business days after you add
them. Until then the refund shows "Awaiting bank details". Never share bank
details in chat.

result.heading: When we send a refund for a cancellation
result.body:
We send the refund at the moment you cancel. A cancelled cash on delivery order has
nothing to refund, because nothing was paid.

result.heading: UPI
result.body:
UPI refunds go back to the UPI ID you paid from and arrive in 1–3 business days
after we send them.

result.heading: Payment methods
result.body:
We accept UPI, cards, wallets and cash on delivery. Cash on delivery orders are
paid to the courier, so they cannot fail this way.

result.heading: If the money has not come back
result.body:
If the money has not come back after 7 business days, contact the support team
(see "Contacting a human") and keep your bank or UPI reference number ready.

result.heading: If the refund has not arrived
result.body:
If the refund has not arrived after the time above, ask Nova to check the refund
status, or contact the support team (see "Contacting a human").
